text: S5.8 decision (lead, 2026-10-04): trial-status changes come from StatusChanges.between(fromLedger, toLedger), joined on TrialKey and listing trials with StudioRefs, with StatusDiff.Compared | Unavailable. FakeStudyBackend serves only r3, so on the fixture the diff says r2 is unavailable instead of inventing r2 transitions. The board's '4 trials change status' literal is met by a two-ledger test, and against the real backend in S3.7.
